resolutions.researcher_notes: current_ref (t7290803.shtml, fgw.gxzf.gov.cn) is geo-blocked (ConnectTimeout, reconfirmed) and has NO web.archive.org snapshot (checked both the availability API and the CDX API directly: cdx query returned '[]' for this exact URL). Fresh Chinese-language search (DDG html + Baidu attempt blocked by captcha) surfaced no source stating this transmission branch pipeline is cancelled. Per this row's own prior deep-sweep audit shard (rows/P7678.json), search-engine cache text for this SAME cited URL actually describes a 2020 notice (桂发改油气〔2020〕1272号) APPROVING AN EXTENSION of the original 2018-12-24 approval (桂发改能源〔2018〕1492号) -- i.e. as of 2020 the approval was still live and being extended, not cancelled, and dated 2020 not 2024. A genuinely different 2024 event exists in the record (a Dec-2024 operating-rights re-tender for '平南县南河片乡镇管道天然气综合利用项目', a downstream TOWN-GAS DISTRIBUTION franchise after operator 华源能源's franchise reportedly failed) but that is an administratively distinct project from this upstream transmission branch pipeline -- citing it here would conflate two different entities. Cannot independently support Status=cancelled/CancelledYear=2024; recommend Update-workflow review with a researcher who can reach fgw.gxzf.gov.cn directly (geo-blocked from this environment) to read t7290803.shtml in full.

Both independently confirm the project is a natural gas pipeline.

Both nishishen.com (Guigang water bureau's water-soil-conservation approval, verified tokens '60.3' and '2.7' present) and eiafans.com (EIA public-disclosure page, verified token '60.3km' present, and full snippet '全长约63km，其中桂平市境内长度为60.3km，平南县境内长度为2.7km') give 60.3km (Guiping) + 2.7km (Pingnan) = 63.00km total, matching the recorded LengthKnown exactly. CAVEAT for the record: a THIRD source, gigeps.com (GIG's own 2019-07 preliminary design-tender notice, GTZX-19-111-016), states a different, smaller figure -- '全长约58km（桂平市55.3km，平南县2.7km）' -- but that document is explicitly the PRELIMINARY-DESIGN-STAGE tender (soliciting the '初步设计及施工图设计', i.e. the design work that produces the final route/length), dated before the final EIA (Aug 2019) and before the water-soil-conservation approval that carries the 63km final figure. Read as an early planning estimate superseded by final design, not a contradiction of the recorded 63.00km -- but flagging explicitly in case a future researcher wants to verify the sequencing.
